placements.why: Establishes the organizational category for disaster recovery, operational readiness, and verified system resilience.
placements.title: operational capabilities require empirical verification and regular rehearsal
placements.frame: How does the organization maintain, verify, and govern operational recovery mechanisms and resilience practices?

placements.title: recovery capabilities are only real when routinely rehearsed
placements.frame: Does this expression treat unverified recovery mechanisms as nonexistent in practice and mandate empirical operational rehearsals?
placements.why: Quinton mandates monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals grounded in the explicit operational maxim that an unrehearsed rollback is not a capability the organization actually possesses.
